tools.name: execute-code
tools.description: Runs Python, JavaScript or TypeScript code in an isolated one-shot sandbox and returns stdout, stderr, exit code and artifacts (Daytona CodeRunRequest/ExecuteResponse compatible) Price: $0.002 a call (3 free calls a day without an API key).

tools.name: execute-command
tools.description: Runs a shell command in an isolated one-shot sandbox and returns stdout, stderr and the exit code (Daytona ExecuteRequest/ExecuteResponse compatible) Price: $0.002 a call (3 free calls a day without an API key).

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "execute-code" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Runs Python, JavaScript or TypeScript code in an isolated one-shot sandbox and returns stdout, stderr, exit code and artifacts (Daytona CodeRunRequest/ExecuteResponse compatible) Price: $0.002 a call." → after: "Runs Python, JavaScript or TypeScript code in an isolated one-shot sandbox and returns stdout, stderr, exit code and artifacts (Daytona CodeRunRequest/ExecuteResponse compatible) Price: $0.002 a call (3 free calls a day without an API key)."
